title: Grok Bot's Pages Feature Now Publishes Static Sites

tickers.name: Space Exploration Technologies Corp. Class A Common Stock

summary:
Members of the Grok user community have discovered a way to host standalone web content through a recently updated page-building utility. While these public static sites are currently described as having limited capabilities, users have found that prompting the bot to bypass certain constraints allows the creation of functional internet pages, such as science-backed personality quizzes.

The capability expands upon a recently launched suite of tools from xAI that allows the chatbot to generate reports, memos, and dashboards. These documents can be co-edited with the AI or set to update automatically to keep data current, a utility Elon Musk likened to employing a "super smart and fun employee."
